messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Wearing my clothes (not swim shorts), and my hair was brown (my hair is black when wet).

output.original_text: Wearing my clothes (not swim shorts), and my hair was brown (my hair is black when wet).
output.joy: I was wearing my favorite clothes, not swim shorts, and my hair looked so lovely and brown, even though it’s black when wet!
output.sadness: I had to wear my clothes instead of my swim shorts, and my hair was a dull brown—I miss the way it looks black when wet.
output.fear: I didn’t wear my swim shorts, just my regular clothes, and my hair was brown, which made me worry about how I’d look in the water.
output.anger: I can’t believe I had to wear my clothes instead of swim shorts, and my stupid hair was brown when it’s usually black when wet!
output.surprise: Surprisingly, I was wearing my normal clothes instead of swim shorts, and my hair was brown, which is unusual since it’s black when wet!
output.disgust: It was gross wearing my regular clothes instead of swim shorts, and my hair looked so weird and brown instead of the usual black when wet.
